opennyai_summary.arguments:
Petitioners are aggrieved by the notification dated 23-09-2020, whereby prohibition on blending of edible vegetable oil with the mustered oil has been imposed w.e.f. 01-10- 2020.
Mr. Agarwala, learned counsel submits that such order of prohibition could not have been issued by the authorities in violation of Section 92 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 more so, when the draft amendment to the regulation has yet to receive the approval of the parliament.
The learned counsel has also invited the attention of this Court to the interim order dated 29-09-2020 passed by the Delhi High Court in ( B.R. Oil Industries Pvt. Ltd Vs. Union of India & Anr. ) staying operation of the notification dated 23-09-2020 so as to contend that keeping in mind uniformity in the matter of judicial orders, a similar interim order is required to be passed in this case as well.
Mr. Pracha, on the other hand, has refuted the submission made by the learned counsel Page No.# 3/4 for the petitioners to contend that the Central Government is not only authorized to issue appropriate instruction to the Food Authority but in the present case, such instructions have been issued keeping in mind the public interest at large insofar as the food safety measures are concerned.
It is also the submission of Mr. Pracha that the interim order dated 29-09-2020 passed by the Delhi High Court was an ex-parte order and the matter is fixed for reconsideration on 22-10-2020.
Mr. Agarwala has, however, submitted that there are number of writ petitions pending on the issue before the Delhi High Court and the interim order passed on 29-09-2020 has already been extended by a subsequent order.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: After hearing the submissions of learned counsel for both the parties, this Court is of the opinion that the matter calls for further examination.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
Issue notice of motion returnable on 09-11-2020.
Since the respondents are already represented, no formal notice is required to be sent in this case.
Extra copies of the writ petition be furnished to the learned departmental counsel within three days from today.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case in its entirety and for the ends of justice, it is hereby provided that operation of the impugned order dated 23-09-2020, Page No.# 4/4 insofar as the writ petitioners are concerned, shall remain suspended till the returnable date.
